Klasse SpawnConfig

java.lang.Object
com.example.guifx.SpawnConfig
public class SpawnConfig extends Object
SpawnConfig defines the rules that determine which vehicles are eligible for spawning. This class is immutable. All provided collections are defensively copied. Changes are impossible from the outside.
